caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned at a slight angle, revealing its front and right side. The chair features a tall backrest with three horizontal slats, all rendered in a textured brown color to represent natural wood grain. The armrests are curved and extend forward, connecting to the front legs, which are turned and cylindrical. The legs are joined by horizontal spindles for structural support. The seat of the chair appears to be made from woven material, colored in shades of brown and tan, creating a textured, interlaced appearance. The rockers at the bottom are elongated, smoothly curved, and attached to the four legs. The background is plain and unadorned, off-white or cream in color, with no additional objects present in the composition. There is a small handwritten note in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Rocking Chair
